description.value: Noble House Suites is a two-room boutique bed & breakfast perched on the bank of the Granby River in Grand Forks, offering a Romance Room with a king bed and wheelchair accessibility and a Daly Room with two queen beds, each with an electric fireplace and soaker tub. Guests have full access to shared amenities including a hot tub, movie theater, full kitchen, and laundry facilities, and the property backs onto riverside walking trails. Hosts Sean and Kathy Noble also operate an on-site confectionery, Noble House Sweets, whose treats are offered to overnight guests.
